bio: Daniel (Danji) Lian First-Year Social Commitee Elm Yard Hi! I’m Danji Lian from Toronto, Canada. I live in Grays Hall and plan on studying Neuroscience and Economics, and might do a secondary in History of Arts and Architecture. Outside of FYSC, I can be found in the dance studio practicing for AADT (yuh!) or some kpop choreography, frequenting the music library (the best one of course) or being locked in psetting at Lamont, and doing casework for CBE. I love reading sci-fi/fantasy books, martial arts, Studio Ghibli movies, and spending too much money at cute bookstores/cafes. Excited to plan vibey events this year and feel free to say hi or reach out with any questions/concerns/recommendations for events.
